subject: general
question: Which of the following animals does not ruminate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pig.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Non-ruminant animals are animals with a **single-compartment stomach,** such as

 
 
• **swine,**
 
• **poultry, **
 
• **horses, **
 
• **dogs,**
 
• **Pig**
 
• **cats, and **
 
• **humans.**
 
 
 
• **Hence Pig ****does not ruminate.**
 
• Non-ruminant nutrition looks at the diet of these animals as it relates to their digestion, growth, performance, and overall health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ruminants **are hoofed herbivorous grazing or browsing mammals that are able to acquire nutrients from plant-based food by fermenting it in a specialized stomach prior to digestion, principally through microbial actions. 
 
• Any mammal of the suborder Ruminantia (order Artiodactyla), which includes the **pronghorns, giraffes, okapis, deer, chevrotains, cattle, antelopes, sheep, and goats. **
 
• Most ruminants have a** four-chambered stomach and two-toed feet.**
